Ui.Script:
-- Step the bar one row (the slider's valueStep) — the sensible step for an item list (the -- generic ref scrollbar steps half its height; a discrete row list wants one). Silent by -- design: the ref plays UChatScrollButton only on the arrow *buttons'* OnClick, never on the -- wheel (ScrollFrameTemplate_OnMouseWheel is soundless). Both the wheel and the arrows call -- this, so the click lives on the arrow OnClick, keeping wheel-scroll silent. function BenillaFauxScrollBar_Step(scrollBar, dir) local step = scrollBar:GetValueStep() if step <= 0 then step = 1 end scrollBar:SetValue(scrollBar:GetValue() + dir * step) end
-- Grey the up arrow at the top and the down arrow at the bottom (ref -- ScrollFrame_OnScrollRangeChanged's arrow handling), from the slider's own value/range. function BenillaFauxScrollBar_UpdateArrows(scrollBar) local minV, maxV = scrollBar:GetMinMaxValues() local val = scrollBar:GetValue() local up = getglobal(scrollBar:GetName() .. "ScrollUpButton") local down = getglobal(scrollBar:GetName() .. "ScrollDownButton") if val <= minV then up:Disable() else up:Enable() end if val >= maxV then down:Disable() else down:Enable() end end
-- The scrollbar's OnValueChanged: derive the row offset from the (pixel) value and, only when -- it actually moved, repaint the owner's list. The change-gate is load-bearing: the owner's -- repaint calls _Update below, which SetValue()s the thumb back to offset*itemHeight — a value -- that maps to the SAME offset, so this handler no-ops and the cycle stops after one hop (the -- Slider's own SetValue change-gate stops the value side, decision 0250). function BenillaFauxScrollBar_OnValueChanged(scrollBar, value) local frame = scrollBar:GetParent() local step = scrollBar:GetValueStep() if step <= 0 then step = 1 end local newOffset = floor(value / step + 0.5) if newOffset ~= frame.offset then frame.offset = newOffset if frame.updateFunc then frame.updateFunc() end end BenillaFauxScrollBar_UpdateArrows(scrollBar) end
-- OnLoad: a fresh faux frame is at the top with an empty range (ref ScrollFrame_OnLoad). function BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnLoad(frame) frame.offset = 0 local scrollBar = getglobal(frame:GetName() .. "ScrollBar") scrollBar:SetMinMaxValues(0, 0) scrollBar:SetValueStep(1) scrollBar:SetValue(0) end
-- The offset getters/setters the owner's list code reads (ref FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset / -- _SetOffset). _SetOffset syncs the thumb too, so a programmatic reset (top-of-list on open) -- moves the bar. function BenillaFauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(frame) return frame.offset or 0 end
function BenillaFauxScrollFrame_SetOffset(frame, offset) frame.offset = offset local scrollBar = getglobal(frame:GetName() .. "ScrollBar") scrollBar:SetValue(offset * scrollBar:GetValueStep()) end
-- Reconcile the bar to a freshly-sized list (ref FauxScrollFrame_Update): clamp the offset into -- range, set the pixel range + step, seat the thumb at the current offset, and show the bar only -- when the list overflows the visible rows. Called by the owner's list-repaint each pass. function BenillaFauxScrollFrame_Update(frame, numItems, numToDisplay, itemHeight) local scrollBar = getglobal(frame:GetName() .. "ScrollBar") local maxOffset = numItems - numToDisplay if maxOffset < 0 then maxOffset = 0 end if not frame.offset or frame.offset > maxOffset then frame.offset = maxOffset end if frame.offset < 0 then frame.offset = 0 end
scrollBar:SetValueStep(itemHeight) scrollBar:SetMinMaxValues(0, maxOffset * itemHeight) scrollBar:SetValue(frame.offset * itemHeight) BenillaFauxScrollBar_UpdateArrows(scrollBar)
if numItems > numToDisplay then scrollBar:Show() else scrollBar:Hide() end end
-- A wheel spin over the list → one row (WoW convention: +1 up, −1 down). Called from the -- owner window's OnMouseWheel (the engine bubbles the spin up the parent chain, so the handler -- lives on the window, not a child — TrainerFrame.xml's own note). function BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel(frame, delta) local scrollBar = getglobal(frame:GetName() .. "ScrollBar") BenillaFauxScrollBar_Step(scrollBar, -delta) end
